execution_assumptions: n and the clause list may grow beyond the regression inputs.
Clauses are supplied as classical data; the cost of representing them in a proposed implementation must be included.
No preloaded quantum memory or measured practical benefit is assumed.
input_domain: n >= 0; each literal is a nonzero signed integer with abs(literal) <= n; empty clause is false; empty clause list is true.
software_contract: Return whether at least one Boolean assignment satisfies every clause.
title: Clause interface
